name: orbiting-circles
blurb: Multiple circles orbit around a center point with configurable speed and direction.
description: Renders child circles positioned equidistantly around an orbit. Each child circles the center point with adjustable duration, speed, radius, and optional visual path.
use_when: Data hubs, team structures, or interconnected concept displays where orbital arrangement visualizes relationships.
avoid_when: Accessibility-critical contexts where motion might distract or confuse users.
a11y: Pure orbital animation; semantic content and keyboard access depend on child elements.
